records.context: One worker holds the raw site (uint16, every image data channel), two label images (int32), the site's stitched flows and their mask post-processing (:data:`SITE_FLOW_BYTES_PER_PIXEL`), the network and one microscope image field in flight (:data:`TILE_BYTES_PER_PIXEL`). The microscope image field is halved from ``seg_tile_px`` down to :data:`MIN_TILE_PX` until it fits; workers are capped by ``seg_workers`` and by the machine's available memory divided by the cap.
records.label: spacr.ops_large_sites.plan_site_memory#1
records.source: One worker holds the raw site (uint16, every channel), two label images (int32), the site's stitched flows and their mask post-processing (:data:`SITE_FLOW_BYTES_PER_PIXEL`), the network and one tile in flight (:data:`TILE_BYTES_PER_PIXEL`). The tile is halved from ``seg_tile_px`` down to :data:`MIN_TILE_PX` until it fits; workers are capped by ``seg_workers`` and by the machine's available memory divided by the cap.
records.translation: 워커 하나는 사이트 원본 (uint16, 모든 채널), 레이블 이미지 두 개 (int32), 사이트의 이어 붙인 flow와 그 마스크 후처리 (:data:`SITE_FLOW_BYTES_PER_PIXEL`), 네트워크, 그리고 처리 중인 타일 하나 (:data:`TILE_BYTES_PER_PIXEL`)를 메모리에 둡니다. 타일은 들어맞을 때까지 ``seg_tile_px``에서 :data:`MIN_TILE_PX`까지 절반으로 줄이며, 워커 수는 ``seg_workers``와 기계의 사용 가능한 메모리를 상한으로 나눈 값으로 제한됩니다.

records.context: Nuclei are segmented on the DNA image data channel, cells on ``cell_channels`` (Phalloidin, then DNA), each normalised once on the whole site (:func:`normalize_site`) and tiled by :func:`segment_tiled` on Cellpose's network grid, with the microscope image fields' flows stitched and Cellpose's mask step run once on the whole site (nuclei only without a diameter, since a diameter resizes each microscope image field); then each nucleus is paired with one cell by :func:`spacr.ops_sample.pair_nuclei_with_cells` (cells without a nucleus are dropped, as in the OPS phenotype path).
records.label: spacr.ops_large_sites.segment_cell_painting_site#1
records.source: Nuclei are segmented on the DNA channel, cells on ``cell_channels`` (Phalloidin, then DNA), each normalised once on the whole site (:func:`normalize_site`) and tiled by :func:`segment_tiled` on Cellpose's network grid, with the tiles' flows stitched and Cellpose's mask step run once on the whole site (nuclei only without a diameter, since a diameter resizes each tile); then each nucleus is paired with one cell by :func:`spacr.ops_sample.pair_nuclei_with_cells` (cells without a nucleus are dropped, as in the OPS phenotype path).
records.translation: 핵은 DNA 채널에서, 세포는 ``cell_channels`` (Phalloidin, 그다음 DNA)에서 분할하며, 각각 사이트 전체에서 한 번 정규화하고 (:func:`normalize_site`) :func:`segment_tiled`로 Cellpose 네트워크 격자 위에서 타일로 나눕니다. 타일의 flow는 이어 붙이고 Cellpose의 마스크 단계는 사이트 전체에서 한 번 실행합니다 (지름은 각 타일의 크기를 바꾸므로 핵은 지름이 없을 때만). 그다음 :func:`spacr.ops_sample.pair_nuclei_with_cells`로 각 핵을 세포 하나와 짝짓습니다 (OPS 표현형 경로처럼 핵이 없는 세포는 버립니다).

records.context: with ``masks`` and ``align``, the network part of ``segment`` (an image to its ``(flows, cellprob)``): the microscope image fields' network outputs are stitched (:func:`stitch_tile_flows`) and ``masks`` turns the whole image's flows into labels once, so that Cellpose's mask steps, which look at the whole image, see what they see untiled. The overlap is raised to ``2 * FLOW_MARGIN_PX``.
records.label: spacr.ops_large_sites.segment_tiled#7
records.source: with ``masks`` and ``align``, the network part of ``segment`` (an image to its ``(flows, cellprob)``): the tiles' network outputs are stitched (:func:`stitch_tile_flows`) and ``masks`` turns the whole image's flows into labels once, so that Cellpose's mask steps, which look at the whole image, see what they see untiled. The overlap is raised to ``2 * FLOW_MARGIN_PX``.
records.translation: ``masks``와 ``align``이 있으면 ``segment``의 네트워크 부분 (이미지에서 그 ``(flows, cellprob)``로)입니다. 타일의 네트워크 출력을 이어 붙이고 (:func:`stitch_tile_flows`) ``masks``가 전체 이미지의 flow를 한 번 레이블로 바꾸므로, 전체 이미지를 보는 Cellpose의 마스크 단계가 비타일 실행과 같은 것을 봅니다. 겹침은 ``2 * FLOW_MARGIN_PX``로 늘어납니다.

records.context: an int32 label image of the image's height and width.
records.label: spacr.ops_large_sites.segment_tiled#9
records.source: an int32 label image of the image's height and width.
records.translation: 이미지와 높이 및 너비가 같은 int32 레이블 이미지.

records.context: One flow microscope field of view and cell probability map from per-tile network outputs.
records.label: spacr.ops_large_sites.stitch_tile_flows#0
records.source: One flow field and cell probability map from per-tile network outputs.
records.translation: 각 타일의 네트워크 출력으로 만든 flow 필드 하나와 세포 확률 지도 하나입니다.

records.context: Each pixel is taken from one microscope image field: along each axis, two neighbouring microscope image fields split the strip they share at its middle, so a pixel comes from the microscope image field in which it lies deepest. With microscope image fields from :func:`tiling_layout` (``align=True``) that overlap by at least ``2 * FLOW_MARGIN_PX``, every pixel's value is the one Cellpose computes for the untiled image, bit for bit.
records.label: spacr.ops_large_sites.stitch_tile_flows#1
records.source: Each pixel is taken from one tile: along each axis, two neighbouring tiles split the strip they share at its middle, so a pixel comes from the tile in which it lies deepest. With tiles from :func:`tiling_layout` (``align=True``) that overlap by at least ``2 * FLOW_MARGIN_PX``, every pixel's value is the one Cellpose computes for the untiled image, bit for bit.
records.translation: 각 픽셀은 타일 하나에서 가져옵니다. 축마다 이웃한 두 타일이 공유하는 띠를 가운데에서 나누므로, 픽셀은 자신이 가장 깊이 들어 있는 타일에서 옵니다. :func:`tiling_layout` (``align=True``)의 타일이 ``2 * FLOW_MARGIN_PX`` 이상 겹치면 모든 픽셀의 값은 Cellpose가 비타일 이미지에 대해 계산하는 값과 비트 단위로 같습니다.

records.source: ``((y0, y1, x0, x1), flows, cellprob)`` per tile, in the row-major order of :func:`tile_grid`; ``flows`` is ``(2, h, w)``.
